summary: Viridian Therapeutics filed an 8-K under Item 1.02 to report the termination of a material definitive agreement. The company voluntarily prepaid approximately $55.1 million to Hercules Capital under the Loan and Security Agreement, originally providing up to $300 million in term loans, of which $50 million was drawn. Upon payment, all obligations were discharged and the loan agreement terminated. This is a routine debt repayment and termination of a credit facility, not a special situation. No strategic transaction, change of control, or shareholder impact is involved.
